title: QUOPS
description: Experimental physical QUOPS with three-ensemble mirror circuit fidelity estimation.

polarization_estimator.description: Polarization estimation method. Currently supports three-ensemble mirror circuit fidelity estimation (MCFE).

gate_set.description: Abstract workload gate set before native compilation. The paper's standard set uses arbitrary Rx/Ry/Rz rotations and all-to-all CNOT pairings.

shapes.description: Predeclared test sequence, strictly increasing in size. Each shape must satisfy width^2 <= size <= width^3 and consist of full rounds plus an optional partial round.

num_circuits.description: Independent QUOPS circuits per shape; each produces one mixed mirror and one reference mirror.

num_spam_circuits.description: Independent state-preparation and measurement reference circuits per width.

seed.description: Seed for circuit sampling, compilation and bootstrap analysis.

max_circuits_per_job.description: Batch limit. Mirror jobs contain only one shape; SPAM references use separate jobs.

physical_qubits.description: Optional fixed physical subset, allowed when all shapes have the same width. Otherwise a subset is selected once per width.

dynamical_decoupling.description: Enable IBM Runtime's XX dynamical decoupling. Supported only on IBM.
